confirmed_additional_supplier_proof_defe.reason: For an ordinary ungraded submodule W, x in W does not imply its homogeneous component x_j in W. Current argument forms sigma(b)x_j and asserts it lies in W. Choosing maximal support label also does not kill the lower-label components when applying a raising word to full x.
confirmed_additional_supplier_proof_defe.surgical_proposal: Choose a minimal label mu_j among finite nonzero homogeneous support of x. Full root-homogeneous nondegeneracy gives homogeneous b in U_q minus[-(lambda-mu_j)] with B(x_j,bv_lambda) nonzero. Apply sigma(b) to full x in W; a different component x_k would land at lambda+mu_k-mu_j, which lies outside lambda-Q+ since minimality rules out mu_k<mu_j, so it vanishes. Thus sigma(b)x=sigma(b)x_j is a nonzero highest-vector multiple in W. Preserve the ordinary-simple Statement.
